prompt.text:
Implement `partitionAssetDirectives(source)`. `source` must be a string; otherwise throw `TypeError`. Recognize a directive only at the start of a line after optional spaces or tabs, using the form `#asset "path"` or `#asset 'path'`. The path must be non-empty and cannot contain its surrounding quote or a line break. A recognized directive ends at its closing quote, so any remaining characters on that line are ordinary text. Lines whose first non-whitespace characters are `//` are ordinary text. Return source-order records shaped as `{ type: 'text' | 'asset', value: string }`. Asset values exclude leading indentation but otherwise preserve spacing inside the directive. Text values must exactly preserve the original characters. Omit only zero-length text records; whitespace-only text records are retained. Return `[]` for an empty string. Do not mutate any input. Export exactly `{ partitionAssetDirectives }` using `module.exports`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
